Name: L_Foot
Description: This will create a Foot System for FK and IK Legs

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create a Foot System for FK and IK Legs.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only).
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 1).
- SetIKCtrl: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- SetFKCtrl: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- SwitchIKFKAttr: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- IkAttrsPosition: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- ParallelToFloor: if checked, the L_Foot_Toes_Ctrl will be oriented parallel to the floor (custom code required in Python).
- Template parent examples: L_Hand_Ankle_Jnt, L_Foot_Ankle_Jnt, L_LegSlideSlideDriver_Loc.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
